name: stress-building
description: Stress test building workloads (request §20-29, §43): real building with turbo and recycling (10 / 25 / 50 players), the dense final zone with builders (50), turbo building at 40, the standing piece count 1,000 / 2,500 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 20,000 (the match budget, with the BudgetFull check), the collapse of 100 / 500 / 1,000-piece structures shot at their foundation, and build spam under (15/s) and over (40/s) the network limit. About 25 minutes (estimated from the single runs of 2026-10-02).
